newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA ARVIN UNIT GETS CHRYSLER EXPORT DEAL.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA ARVIN UNIT GETS CHRYSLER EXPORT DEAL.

text.p: Chrysler South Africa, a unit of American automaker Chrysler Corp, and Arvin Exhaust, a local maker of catalytic convertors, said on Thursday they had sealed a 20 million rand export deal to Europe.

They said in a statement that Cape Town-based Arvin Exhaust, a wholly-owned subsidiary of U.S.-based Arvin Industries Inc, had received an order from Chrysler Corp's Austrian unit for 40,000 catalytic convertors for its 1998 Jeep Grand Cherokee vehicles.

Arvin, in the United States, has been a Chrysler supplier since the 1920s and delivery of the first shipment of 2,400 converters to Chrysler Corp's Eurostar assembly plant in Graz, Austria, is due in November, the statement said.
